summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 tests), and test/test_extras passes (100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only; the with pytest.raises line in the parametrized test carries no ignore comment because isinstance narrows the type there.
